narr: A stalled front coupled with weak storm motion resulted in slow moving storms with heavy rainfall and flash flooding.

Multiple motorists were stranded in flooded roadways in North Myrtle Beach. Water also entered the buildings of businesses in this area.
Significant flooding was reported on 24th Ave N. in Myrtle Beach with water above vehicle wheel wells. Police closed 24th Ave N. due to the flooding.
Video of flash flooding was recorded entering the Buena Vista Plaza hotel in North Myrtle Beach.
Roads were impassable due to flooding in the Ocean Lakes Campground area.
